subtitle: Weather-aware test schedules with approval and read-back
description: Ripple is an OctoSense script app prototype for reviewing weather conflicts before changing an outdoor test schedule. It retrieves real hourly forecasts from Open-Meteo for coordinates you enter, creates one synthetic 60-minute test schedule in its own storage, and proposes a dry earlier time on the same UTC+8 day. Analysis does not change the schedule. You can confirm, decline, or cancel a proposal. Confirmation checks that the source schedule and weather are still current, writes the approved time, then independently reads the stored record. COMPLETED appears only when the read-back matches the expected schedule. Empty, failure, and stale states are visible, and a verified stored result survives app restart. This preliminary version uses only app-owned test data; it does not access Google Calendar or your personal calendar. It has been exercised on Windows card-host; other platforms and the full OctoSense shell have not been verified.
release_notes: Initial native OctoScript prototype: live Open-Meteo weather, app-owned synthetic schedule, pending proposals, explicit approval, independent storage read-back, decline/cancel/stale/failure/empty states, and restart persistence. Windows card-host tested.
